provenance.source: Teneggi 2013 Supplemental Experimental Procedures, PDF pp. 7-9 of 11, https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S096098221300078X-mmc1.pdf. Experiment 3: N=20, IN only, 4 s sound, 500 ms pre/post silence, seven SOAs 250/750/1300/1800/2500/3200/3700 ms; 100-microsecond electrical pulses. The preceding 8 x 5 x 2 = 80 target +24 catch count applies to Experiments 1/2, not Experiment 3.

One-per-SOA preview counts, binaural premade Gaussian burst-train asset, and 100-ms audio-channel tactile cue are explicit toolkit substitutions. Social intervention and original apparatus are not recreated.

notes: This manifest audits recreation inside the PPS Toolkit GUI. It distinguishes toolkit-generated recreations of reported parameters from the original authors' exact stimulus set.
